product_overview: Advus is a web-based legal practice management platform that centralizes clients, processes (Kanban), financials and dashboard analytics in a single dark-themed interface. It helps small and medium law firms manage cases, clients and cashflow while surfacing high-level metrics for quick decision making.
core_goals: Register and manage clients (PF/CNPJ) and view their linked processes, notes and financial records
Track legal processes using a Kanban board and update status and deadlines
Record, review and export financial transactions and reports
Provide a dashboard with configurable metric blocks for quick navigation to detailed areas

features.name: Login
features.description: Authenticate into the application to access protected areas like the dashboard, clients, processes and finance modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Submit valid email and password -> Navigate to /app/dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Submit form without required fields -> See validation errors preventing submission

features.name: Global Rebrand to Advus
features.description: Present a unified premium dark design across the platform so users immediately recognize the Advus brand and visual language.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> See rebranded Welcome overlay -> Submit valid credentials -> Navigate to /app/dashboard -> See unified sidebar and topbar -> See metrics cards with glassmorphism

features.name: Dashboard Interaction
features.description: Show high-level stats, deadlines and recent activity with interactive blocks that users can reorder and use to jump to detailed pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/dashboard -> Drag and drop blocks to reorder -> Toggle financial values visibility -> Click a metrics card -> Navigate to /app/financeiro

features.name: Clients Management
features.description: Create and maintain client records for both Pessoa Física (CPF) and Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ), and view a client's linked processes, notes and financial history.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/clientes -> Create a new client by entering required data including CPF or CNPJ -> Submit client form -> See new client listed -> Open client details -> See linked processes, notes and financial records
Navigate to /app/clientes -> Attempt to create client without CPF or CNPJ -> See validation error preventing save

features.name: Processes Management (Kanban)
features.description: Manage legal processes on a Kanban board, track status changes, store process metadata and update deadlines and responsibilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/processos -> Create a new process by entering process number, tribunal, area and responsible -> Submit process form -> See process card appear on Kanban board -> Drag and drop process card to change status -> Open process details -> Edit deadline -> Save changes -> See updated deadline on process details
Navigate to /app/processos -> Attempt to create process without process number -> See validation error preventing save

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Record revenues and expenses, track honorários and generate financial reports and exports to support cashflow management.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/financeiro -> Add a transaction by entering type, amount and date -> Submit transaction -> See transaction listed in ledger -> Filter transactions by date range -> Export filtered transactions to PDF report
Navigate to /app/financeiro -> Attempt to add a transaction with missing or negative amount -> See validation error preventing save

features.description: Unified premium dark design across the platform.
user_interactions: View rebranded Welcome overlay on login
